meta.title: LEVAKANT RESIDENCE — residential complex in Levakant
meta.description: LEVAKANT RESIDENCE — a new residential building on Ismoili Somoni Street in Levakant: 9 floors plus an attic level, apartments from 35 to 134 m², a 3D model of the building, layouts, prices and instalments.

about.levakantResidenceIsA: LEVAKANT RESIDENCE is a new building in central Levakant, on Ismoili Somoni Street: the lyceum, a park and the stadium are close by, and the shops are right in the building. Nine floors and an attic level. Built by Akai Mu’min.
about.streetFacingWindowsGet: Street-facing windows get 8–9 hours of direct sun a day, even in December — checked with a 3D sun study for Levakant.
about.twoLiftsAndTwo: Two lifts and two staircases: shorter morning queues and an easy ride up with a pram or shopping bags.
about.theGroundFloorAnd: 1,647 m² on the two lower levels — room for a supermarket, a pharmacy and everyday services right downstairs.
about.aPlaygroundLawnsAnd: A playground, lawns and trees in the courtyard, parking along the building — per the site plan. Room for children to play and a space for the car.
about.closeToLeninStreet: Lenin Street, Victory Park, the stadium and Lyceum No. 1 are all close by. Central Bokhtar is about 15 minutes by car.
about.apartmentsOfUpTo: Apartments of up to 133.56 m² on the attic level: room for a big family and a view over the city from the windows.
about.levakantResidenceCornerPerspecti: LEVAKANT RESIDENCE — corner perspective, architectural rendering
about.noMarkUp30: no mark-up · 30% down · up to 24 months

building.noteGl: The model is the Archicad export of this design with windows, doors and interior walls, shown in real time in the browser. Apartments are tinted by the design layouts, furniture follows the floor plans. Trees, street lights and neighbouring blocks are indicative surroundings. Light follows the sun over the site: day 22 September, 12:30; evening 21 November, 16:15; lit windows are indicative.
building.noteStatic: Façades on all four sides, the roof, the site and floor sections are renders of this design’s Archicad model; floor heights come from it too (typical floor 3.15 m). Light follows the sun position for the site: day 22 September, 12:30; evening 21 November, 16:15. On the page this is a simplified volume of floor blocks, not the BIM model itself; lit windows at dusk and night are indicative.
